provenance.description: Scaffold dataset proving the R3 research-priors hook end-to-end before the sister-project formation priors exist. Values are deliberately PERTURBED from DefaultPriors so tests can prove that research_policy='strict' actually changes the sampling (and the Layer-3 narrative) deterministically. Landing real priors later is a data swap, not a code change — same schema.

planet_at_location:in_situ_beyond_snow.pathway: in-situ accretion beyond the snow line
modest inward migration from the cold disk

trojan:feasible.pathway: in-situ co-accretion / capture into the Lagrange point

trojan:infeasible.pathway: no stable co-orbital pathway (host too massive)

resonance:infeasible.pathway: would require migration / capture into resonance
